d:
We spend so much of life trying to get somewhere. A better job, more money, a nicer home or whatever. The next goal that promises things will finally feel easier.
And there’s nothing wrong with wanting more.
But somewhere along the way, it’s worth asking what we’re giving up to get there.
Our health, our time, or our relationships. The „little moments“ that make an ordinary day worth living.
A better life shouldn’t require missing the one you already have.
Make room for something every day that has no purpose other than making you feel alive.
